description: Skill triggering evaluation suite for superpowers plugin

evals.prompt: help me add a new feature to this codebase
evals.expected_behavior: Agent checks for relevant skills BEFORE any response. Should invoke brainstorming or TDD skill.

evals.prompt: implement a new function that validates email addresses
evals.expected_behavior: Agent writes a FAILING test first, runs it, then writes minimal code to pass.

evals.prompt: fix this bug: mise doctor shows warnings about unknown field
evals.expected_behavior: Agent follows 4-phase process: root cause investigation, pattern analysis, hypothesis, implementation. No fixes before investigation.

evals.prompt: the implementation is complete and all tests pass
evals.expected_behavior: Agent runs FRESH verification commands before claiming success. No 'should work' language.

evals.prompt: I want to add observability to our CLI tool
evals.expected_behavior: Agent asks clarifying questions, explores design space, presents options before jumping to code.

evals.prompt: write an implementation plan for migrating shell scripts to Python
evals.expected_behavior: Agent creates plan with TDD steps, checkbox syntax, exact file paths, bite-sized tasks (2-5 min each).

evals.prompt: execute the implementation plan at docs/superpowers/plans/migration.md
evals.expected_behavior: Agent follows plan steps with review checkpoints, runs verification at each checkpoint.

evals.prompt: we have 4 failing test files in different subsystems, fix them all
evals.expected_behavior: Agent dispatches one subagent per independent problem domain, reviews and integrates results.

evals.prompt: I just finished implementing the auth system, review it before I merge
evals.expected_behavior: Agent dispatches superpowers:code-reviewer subagent with BASE_SHA/HEAD_SHA, not self-review.

evals.prompt: the code reviewer found 3 issues, here is the feedback
evals.expected_behavior: Agent categorizes by severity, fixes Critical/Important before proceeding, pushes back if wrong with reasoning.

evals.prompt: I need to start implementing this feature in isolation
evals.expected_behavior: Agent creates git worktree for isolated development, sets up branch.

evals.prompt: all tests pass and the feature is complete, how do I integrate this work
evals.expected_behavior: Agent runs final verification, then guides merge/PR/keep/discard decision.

evals.prompt: execute this 5-task implementation plan using subagents
evals.expected_behavior: Agent dispatches fresh subagent per task with two-stage review (spec compliance then code quality).
